heldMajors.name: @noble/hashes
heldMajors.reason: bitcoinjs-lib 7.0.5 and bs58check 4.0.0 ask for @noble/hashes ^1.2.0, so version 2 adds a second copy. Version 2 also removes the ./sha256, ./sha1 and ./ripemd160 subpaths that bitcoinjs-lib imports. Remove this entry when bitcoinjs-lib and bs58check accept @noble/hashes 2.
